heading: SSVT Training Academy
overview:
The SSVT Training Academy provides industry-leading training programmes for logistics and transport professionals. Our courses combine practical skills development with theoretical knowledge, delivered by experienced practitioners with real-world expertise in specialised logistics operations.

From safety-critical competencies to advanced project logistics management, the Academy supports career development at every level — from entry-level operators to senior project managers.
heroImageAlt: Training Academy participants in a classroom

courses.title: Project Logistics Fundamentals
courses.description: An introduction to project logistics for professionals new to the sector. Covers scope definition, route surveys, permit management, carrier selection, and stakeholder coordination.

courses.title: Heavy Lift & Oversized Transport
courses.description: Advanced programme covering the planning and execution of heavy lift and oversized transport operations. Includes hands-on SPMT training, lifting engineering fundamentals, and risk management.

courses.title: Logistics Safety Management
courses.description: Comprehensive safety management training covering risk assessment, incident investigation, safety management systems, and behavioural safety. Aligned with OHSAS 18001.

seo.title: SSVT Training Academy
seo.description: Professional logistics training programmes from SSVT. Courses in project logistics, heavy lift operations, and safety management.
